Every recommendation is checked against the two supplied resumes, including required experience, specialization, workplace, and location. recommendations.title: Product Manager, News Product - Community
recommendations.matchReason: Her product-owner work directly covers roadmaps, requirements, tickets, backlogs, Agile ceremonies, stakeholder collaboration, user research, and quantitative product insights.
recommendations.requirementsCheck: Meets the 2+ years product/relevant-experience minimum. Gap: the application requires NYC/Tri-State residency and a two-day office commute; her resume says Syracuse.

recommendations.title: Technical Program Manager 2, FreeWheel
recommendations.matchReason: Her delivery resume directly covers Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, cross-team dependencies, SDLC, Jira, Confluence, risk tracking, planning, and stakeholder communication.
recommendations.requirementsCheck: Meets the listed bachelor's degree and 2–5 years relevant-experience range. Gaps: this is Reston hybrid, while her resume says Syracuse, and the role includes mentoring junior team members.

recommendations.title: Product Manager, Checkout Experience
recommendations.matchReason: Her B2B e-commerce marketplace, conversion-funnel analytics, customer research, A/B testing, onboarding work, and engineering/design partnership align closely with the product itself.
recommendations.requirementsCheck: Near the 4+ years product-management minimum when product-owner and closely related BA work are combined. Gaps: limited explicit SaaS checkout, subscription-billing, and payments-platform experience; her resume says Syracuse.

recommendations.title: Program Manager, Enterprise Technology
recommendations.matchReason: Her combined delivery history covers simultaneous technical projects, Agile delivery, Jira, risk mitigation, status reporting, testing, documentation, stakeholder workshops, and process improvement.
recommendations.requirementsCheck: Her relevant work across 2017–2025 can support the 5+ year minimum, although not all roles carried a program-manager title. Gaps: NYC/Tri-State hybrid commute and no production-facility or industrial-project experience (preferred, not required).
